Sundial Wait Menu
=================
Version 1.0.0

An original, GPL-3.0-or-later OBSE64 plugin for The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered. The game's wait and sleep
menu drawn as a round dial.

WHAT IT DOES
------------
  * A parchment astrolabe face of its own, with an hour ring and the day's four marks in medallions on the rim:
    sunrise on the left, noon at the top, sunset on the right, midnight at the bottom.
  * The hours you choose are lit along the rim from the current hour, and a gilt sun sits at the current hour.
  * While the game waits, the lit hours tick away one by one as the sun moves round.
  * It is drawn inside the game's own menu. The title, the hours slider, the texts and the buttons are the game's own,
    so the controls work as before and the text stays in your language. The title sits above the dial, the hours,
    time and date sit on its face, and the buttons sit below.

INSTALLATION
------------
  * Install with your mod manager, or copy OblivionRemastered\ into the game folder. Mod Organizer 2 users need Root
    Builder, as for every OBSE plugin.
  * Requires OBSE64 and Address Library for OBSE Plugins.

SETTINGS
--------
  OblivionRemastered\Binaries\Win64\OBSE\Plugins\SundialWaitMenu.ini: on/off, the dial's size, the gaps above and
  below it, brown ink for the text on the face, and the log level.

REPORTING A PROBLEM
-------------------
  Send Documents\My Games\Oblivion Remastered\OBSE\Logs\SundialWaitMenu.log. Set uLogLevel=1 in the INI first for
  more detail. The debug symbols (.pdb) ship beside the DLL, so a crash log names this plugin's functions.

LICENCE
